rules.entry: At clear support or resistance level
rules.stop_loss: Below real support or above real resistance — add buffer. Never move Stop Loss against trade direction.
rules.trailing_stop: Activate trailing stop at 50% toward Take Profit
rules.time_exit: Close if no meaningful movement after 48 hours
rules.position_size: 1% of portfolio per trade — calculate units properly
rules.max_portfolio_risk: 5% total across ALL open trades at any time
rules.scoring: Score every trade before placing on: catalyst strength, trend clarity, session timing, risk/reward
rules.replacement_rule: If a new trade scores higher than an existing open trade — recommend cancelling the weaker one and replacing it

watchlist_reference: Uses the full watchlist.json in project root — all sessions (London, NY, Crypto)
